privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for Alopex Digital - how we collect, use and protect your data

introduction.title: 1. Who we are
introduction.content: Alopex Digital OÜ (registry code 17180489) is responsible for the personal data described here. This policy covers our website, the forms on it, our business emails and job applications. When we build or run a system for a client and it handles the client's own data, we act on the client's instructions as a processor. That work is covered by our agreement with the client, not by this policy.

dataCollected.title: 2. What we collect and why
dataCollected.content: We only collect what we need for the purposes below.
items: Booking a call: your email, the kind of work you choose and the time you pick. We use them to arrange and prepare the call (steps before a contract, GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
Free manual-work check: your answers and, if you give it, your email. We use them to show your result and, if you leave your email, to send it and follow up (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f)).
Newsletter: your email. We send one email a month until you unsubscribe (consent, Art. 6(1)(a)).
Job applications: your name, email, the role you want and what you write to us. We use them to assess your application (steps before a contract, Art. 6(1)(b)).
Clients: contact details, contracts and invoices. We need them to deliver the work and to meet accounting law (contract and legal obligation, Art. 6(1)(b) and (c)).
Website use: pages visited, device and approximate location. We collect them with cookies, and only after you agree (consent, Art. 6(1)(a)).

b2bMarketing.title: 3. B2B direct marketing
b2bMarketing.content: We send emails about our services to company representatives (board members, sales and marketing leads). Contact details (name, role, work email address, company) come from public sources: the Estonian Business Register, company websites, LinkedIn and public business directories. We process them on the basis of legitimate interest (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)) and § 103¹ of the Estonian Electronic Communications Act, which permits direct marketing to a legal person's contact address provided the recipient can easily opt out. Every email contains an opt-out. We honour opt-outs the same day and add the contact to a suppression list so we do not write again. Emails are sent through Instantly.ai (processor) and replies are stored in our CRM (GoHighLevel). We keep a contact until opt-out or 12 months after the last correspondence; the suppression list is kept to enforce the opt-out. You may object to this processing at any time (GDPR Art. 21): reply to the email with the word "eemalda" or "unsubscribe", or write to info@alopex.digital. To find these public details and check that an email address works, we also use data tools such as Clay.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies
cookies.content: Necessary cookies keep the site working and are always on. Analytics cookies (Google Analytics) and marketing cookies (Meta Pixel) are set only after you agree in the cookie banner, which is run by CookieYes. You can change your choice at any time in the cookie banner.

thirdParties.title: 5. Who we share data with
thirdParties.content: We do not sell personal data. We use these service providers, who process data on our behalf:
items: GoHighLevel: CRM, calendar and forms
Hetzner Online: hosting of the website and our servers in the EU
Google: email, documents and Google Analytics
Meta: Meta Pixel and advertising
CookieYes: cookie consent
Instantly.ai: sending business emails
Clay: finding public company and contact details for business emails
AI providers, when a task needs AI. The providers used in a client project are named in the agreement with that client.
n8n: automation software that we run on our own servers in the EU
thirdParties.after: Some providers are based in the United States. Transfers there rely on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.

retention.title: 6. How long we keep data
items: Call bookings and enquiries: 3 years after our last contact.
Free-check answers: 3 years after our last contact.
Newsletter: until you unsubscribe. After that we keep proof of your consent for 3 years, and your email on a do-not-send list.
Job applications: 6 months after we decide. Longer only if you agree, for example so we can consider you for a later role.
Business email contacts: until you opt out, or 12 months after the last correspondence.
Client data and invoices: the length of the contract plus 7 years, as accounting law requires.
Analytics data: 26 months.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.content: You can ask us to show, correct or delete your data, to limit or stop using it, or to give it to you in a portable format. You can withdraw your consent at any time, and object to direct marketing at any time. Write to info@alopex.digital. We reply within one month.

contact.content: For privacy questions or to use your rights:

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.metaDescription: Terms of Service for Alopex Digital - rules governing use of our services

introduction.title: 1. About these terms
introduction.content: These terms apply to the website, services and software products of Alopex Digital OÜ (registry code 17180489). If we have signed an offer or a contract with you, it takes precedence over these terms.

services.title: 2. What we provide
items: Custom automation: systems built for one company and connected to the tools it already uses.
AI assistants and training: AI set up for specific tasks, and training for the team.
Ready-made products: software we run for many companies, such as Sales Machine, accounting automation and GHL Email Sync, on the terms in the offer.
Support and maintenance: monitoring, fixes and improvements for the systems we run.

process.title: 3. How a project works
items: The first call is free and does not commit you to anything.
The blueprint has a fixed fee that we agree before we start. If you then build with us, the fee is deducted from the build. If you don't, you keep the plan.
The build has a fixed price and scope, agreed in writing after the blueprint. Work outside that scope is agreed and priced separately.

obligations.title: 4. Your obligations
obligations.content: You give us correct information and the access we need, answer our questions in reasonable time, keep your passwords safe, follow the law and pay invoices on time.

payment.title: 5. Payment
payment.content: Invoices are in euros and due 14 days from the invoice date, unless the offer says otherwise. Late payment interest is 0.05% per day. We may pause services if an invoice is more than 30 days overdue.

ip.title: 6. Intellectual property
ip.content: We keep ownership of the tools, code and methods we had before the project. Once you have paid in full, you own what we built specifically for you, as well as your own settings and data.

data.title: 7. Personal data
data.content: When our work involves personal data that you are responsible for, we process it only on your instructions, as a processor under GDPR Art. 28. On request, we sign a data processing agreement with you.

confidentiality.title: 8. Confidentiality
confidentiality.content: Both sides keep the other side's confidential information private, use it only for the work and do not share it with others without consent. This lasts for 3 years after the cooperation ends.

thirdParty.title: 9. Third-party tools
thirdParty.content: Many systems run on third-party platforms, such as CRMs, email and accounting software. Their availability, prices and terms are set by those providers, not by us.

liability.title: 10. Limitation of liability
liability.content: Our total liability is limited to the fees you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. We are not liable for indirect damage, lost profit or problems caused by third-party services.

termination.title: 11. Ending the cooperation
termination.content: Either side can end the cooperation with 30 days' notice, or at once if the other side seriously breaches these terms and does not fix it within 14 days. You pay for the work done until the end.

governing.title: 12. Governing law
governing.content: These terms are governed by Estonian law. Disputes are settled in Harju County Court, Estonia.
